rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice when a person, skill, or thing becomes part of an activity, group, or environment.

example.english: The new colleague quickly managed to integrate into our team.
example.traditional: 新同事好快就融入咗我哋個團隊。
example.jyutping: san1 tung4 si6 hou2 faai3 zau6 jung4 jap6 zo2 ngo5 dei6 go3 tyun4 deoi2

rows.note: Choose this when compatible components, information, or functions are deliberately combined into one system or whole.

example.english: We need to integrate the data from several departments into one platform.
example.traditional: 我哋要將幾個部門嘅資料整合成一個平台。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jiu3 zoeng1 gei2 go3 bou6 mun4 ge3 zi1 liu2 zing2 hap6 sing4 jat1 go3 ping4 toi1

rows.note: Use this specifically for carrying out integration in calculus.

example.english: For this problem, you need to integrate first to find the area.
example.traditional: 呢條題目要先做積分，先可以搵到面積。
example.jyutping: ne1 tiu4 tai4 muk6 jiu3 sin1 zou6 zik1 fan1 sin1 ho2 ji5 wan2 dou3 min6 zik1
